name: Jari Koskinen
bio:
Jari's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. He was working as a warehouse manager for a construction firm when a local rally team needed someone to organize their equipment and transportation. Jari's natural talent for logistics and his meticulous approach quickly made him indispensable. He thrived under pressure and enjoyed the challenge of coordinating complex movements across different terrains and time zones.

Over the years, Jari has honed his skills, becoming known for his ability to anticipate problems and find creative solutions. He believes that clear communication and a strong understanding of the team's needs are essential for success. Jari's calm demeanor and unwavering loyalty make him a valuable asset to any motorsport team. He is now looking for a new challenge to contribute his expertise and further enhance the operational efficiency of a racing team.

physical.description: A stocky man with a kind face and perpetually furrowed brow, suggesting constant problem-solving.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in his dreams.
Has a specific routine for packing and unpacking equipment, which must be followed precisely.
Repeatedly adjusts his glasses, even if they are not askew.
